name: Misericordia Church and Senate House, Macao
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary: A view of Senado Square, Macau: on the left are the church and the shaded tower of Santa Casa da Misericordia; ahead is the Leal Senado, Macau's municipal chamber. For comparable views see E. 1732-1928 and E.1735-1928.
